author: bwalrus0202
body:
Officially still in mourning over the closure of Sabatino's on Lido Island, best sausage ever made, hands down.

For places still open, there is Oriental Chinese Cuisine in Placentia. Great American-style Chinese food, run by the whole family. Double upvote for El Farolito!

author: dp6s
body: Dang rip sabatinos. Definitely going el farolito soon and oriental Chinese cuisine looks so nostalgic
